messages:
mia: main turned red right after the fast-merge. e2e-smoke timed out in runtime-kernel step (only on linux-gpu matrix). can someone grab a quick bisect?

cheng: saw the alert. reran the job manually but it timed out again. putting the failing step log below: 

mia: ```
[2026-03-17T21:20:11Z] STEP runtime-kernel: running tests
[2026-03-17T21:25:11Z] ERROR: Timeout waiting for kernel init (120s)
[2026-03-17T21:25:12Z] Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "test_runner.py", line 402, in <module>
    run_suite()
  File "test_runner.py", line 213, in run_suite
    kernel.start()

-- logs truncated --
```

alex: hmm looks like a kernel API change could cause init to hang. any recent merges touching runtime/kernels or container entrypoints? @cheng do you know?

cheng: quick grep across merged PRs since the fast-merge shows PR #4829 touched GPU init path, container startup delay logic. filing a bisect now.

ci-bot: Rerun triggered: pipeline/ci-e2e-smoke (rerun by cheng) — job 4829-rerun-1.

sam: if bisect points to that PR we should either hotfix the init back to previous flow or revert. holding off on revert until bisect finishes unless it's clearly the culprit.

cheng: bisect progress: tested commit range [main~6..main]. narrowed to commits around PR 4829. running the narrow pass now (3 runs).

mia: any chance this is infra flakiness? GPU driver update in the infra rollout earlier today?

alex: infra flagged a rolling driver update at 20:30 UTC but it targeted only staging clusters, not the prod CI runners. still, behavior could surface if startup timing changed. filing an infra-check ticket: https://infra.internal/tickets/1007

ci-bot: bisect update: failing at commit abc1234 (merge of PR #4829).

cheng: confirmed: replacing the changed startup delay in PR 4829 with previous value fixes the timeout locally. looks like a timing regression in kernel init.

sam: ok proposal: revert PR 4829 in main to get CI green, then follow up with a proper fix and test harness for init timing. any objections? :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:

mia: +1 — revert and open a follow-up with e2e that simulates slow init.

alex: +1. will prepare revert PR and tag eng-oncall for immediate merge.

cheng: created revert PR #4831 and requested expedited review. linking CI run: https://ci.internal/builds/4831

ci-bot: deploy-notify: revert PR #4831 merged to main by alex — CI will re-run workflows automatically.

mia: thanks all. after this stabilizes let's add a flaky-test guard and a retry for kernel init with backoff rather than fixed delay.

alex: noted, I'll add an on-call playbook note about kernel-init timeouts and add a tiny repro test in runtime tests.

sam: good coordination. marking this thread resolved once main is green. :white_check_mark:
